question: Does delivery-% conviction (deliv_x20) improve 3rd-down-day washout bounces? Expect higher deliv_x20 = better stop-R (real accumulation into the dip, not panic churn).
plain: For stocks down three days in a row, this checks whether the dip days with unusually high delivery (real buyers stepping in, not just day-traders) bounce better than dip days with low delivery.
